name: GAN 16 3x3 MaxL (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated)
description: The GAN 16 3x3 MaxL (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) is a premium magnetic speed cube designed for cubers who want a faster, more stable feel with extra grip and a slightly larger size for added control. Standard magnets help pieces click into place more accurately, MagLev replaces springs for a lighter, lower-resistance turning feel, and core magnets add stability for a more precise, predictable solve.
features: Cleaner, more accurate turning: Magnetic positioning helps pieces align more consistently during solves.
Fast, low-resistance feel: MagLev replaces springs with repelling magnets for quicker, smoother turning.
Better control: Core magnets improve stability and make the cube feel more predictable at speed.
More secure grip: UV coating adds a super glossy surface with high grip.
Larger handling feel: 57mm size is designed for greater control and a more precise grip.
MagLev setup: Creates a lighter, faster turning feel by reducing internal spring resistance.
